mapper.insert: INSERT INTO RECENT_PLACES ( userId, kakaoPlaceId, placeName, address, roadAddress, lat, lng, searchedAt ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{kakaoPlaceId}, #{placeName}, #{addressName}, #{roadAddressName}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE placeName = VALUES(placeName), address = VALUES(address), roadAddress = VALUES(roadAddress), lat = VALUES(lat), lng = VALUES(lng), searchedAt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)
mapper.select: SELECT recentPlaceId, userId, kakaoPlaceId, placeName, address, roadAddress, lat, lng, searchedAt FROM RECENT_PLACES WHERE userId = #{userId} ORDER BY searchedAt DESC, recentPlaceId DESC LIMIT 10
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO FAVORITE_PLACES ( userId, kakaoPlaceId, category, placeName, address, roadAddress, lat, lng ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{kakaoPlaceId}, #{category}, #{placeName}, #{addressName}, #{roadAddressName}, #{latitude}, #{longitude} )
mapper.select: SELECT favoritePlaceId, userId, kakaoPlaceId, category, placeName, address, roadAddress, lat, lng, regDt FROM FAVORITE_PLACES WHERE userId = #{userId} AND kakaoPlaceId IS NOT NULL ORDER BY regDt DESC, favoritePlaceId DESC
